headword: {料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}
gloss: fee revision; rate change; price adjustment

definitions.gloss: fee revision; rate change; price adjustment
definitions.explanation: The official adjustment or revision of prices, fees, or rates charged for a service or product. Often used for public utilities, transportation fares, and subscription services.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}から{料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}がある。
examples.english: There will be a rate change starting next month.

examples.japanese: {運賃|うんちん}の{料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}により、{来月|らいげつ}から{新|あたら}しい{運賃|うんちん}が{適用|てきよう}される。
examples.english: Due to the fare revision, new fares will be applied from next month.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{原材料費|げんざいりょうひ}の{高騰|こうとう}を{理由|りゆう}に{料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The company announced a price revision citing the surge in raw material costs.

notes:
Composed of {料金|りょうきん} (fee, charge) and {改定|かいてい} (revision, amendment). Used when prices or rates are officially changed, whether increased or decreased. Often appears in formal announcements from service providers, utilities, and transportation companies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}の{通知|つうち}: notice of rate revision
- {料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}を{実施|じっし}する: to implement a fee revision
- {料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい}の{理由|りゆう}: reason for the price change

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {値上|ねあ}げ: price increase — specifically means raising prices, while {料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい} is neutral and can mean either direction
- {価格|かかく}{変更|へんこう}: price change — more general term that can apply to individual products, while {料金|りょうきん}{改定|かいてい} implies a systematic, official revision
- {改定|かいてい} vs {改訂|かいてい}: both read かいてい, but {改定|かいてい} revises rules/rates while {改訂|かいてい} revises written texts like books
